content: Yuhuda Kawo Abiya
Nabaaxe naa Iyorba7aamey kawotida tammanne osppunththa layththan Abiyay Yuhudan kawotides.
Abiyay Yerusalaamen heedzdzu layth kawotides; iza aayeya Abeseloome bolloto; izi sunththayka Ma7ikko.
Izi kase iza aaway ooththida nagara ubbaa ooththides; iza wozinay iza mayza Dawite wozinay kumeth ammanettida mala GODAA ba Xoossaas kumeth ammanettibeenna.
Gidikkoka izappe guye Yerusalaamen kawotana malanne Yerusalaame saroteththaa naagana mala GODAA iza Xoossay Dawite gishshas Abiyas issi attuma naa immides.
GODAY hessa ooththiday Dawiti Hiite as Ooriyo bolla ooththida nagarayppe attiin GODAA sinththan suure miish ooththides; ba de7o layth ubbaan GODAA azazotappe kare kezibeenna.
Abiyay kawotida layth ubbaan Abiya asaaranne Erobi7aame asaara bantta giddon olettishe de7ida.
Abiyay ooththida hara miishshati ubbay Yuhuda kawota taarike maxaafan xaafetti uttida. Abiyaynne Iyorba7aamey bantta giddon olettishe de7ida.
Abiyay hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttides; izi Dawite kataman moogettides. Iza sohonkka iza naa Aasi kawotides.
Yuhuda Kawo Aasa
Isra7eele kawo Iyorba7aamey kawotida nam7u tammanththa layththan Aasi Yuhudan kawotides.
Aasi Yerusalaamen 41 layth kawotides; iza aawaa aaya Abeseloome biyo Ma7ikko.
Aasi ba makakulle Dawiti ooththida mala GODAA sinththan suure miish ooththides.
Goyno woga polanaas para layma laymatizayta Aasi ba biittafe dhayssides; izappe kase de7ida kawoti ooththida eeqa xoossa misleta ubbaa dhoqqalereththi yeggides.
Iza aawa aaya Ma7ika Asheero geetettiza harassiza eeqa misle medhdhida gishshas godatteyntta geetettiza bonchchofe izo diggides. Aasi he eeqa misleza qanxxereththidi Qediroone Zullen xuuggides.
Aasi zumbullata bolla goynnizasohota ubbaa dhayssontta aggikokka izi ba de7ida layth ubbaan Xoossas wozinappe ammanettiza as gidi de7ides.
Izinne iza aaway Xoossas dummasi woththida biraa, worqqaanne hara miishshata ehidi GODAA Xoossa Keeththa giddon woththides.
Yuhuda Kawo Aasinne Isra7eele Kawo Baashey bantta de7o layth ubbaan olettishe de7ida.
Isra7eele Kawo Baashey Yuhuda bolla worajjidi Yuhuda kawo Aasa biitta gelontta malanne ke7ontta mala teqqanaas Eraama katama yuuyi aadhdhanaas miixa histti gimbides.

Hessa gaason Kawo Aasi GODAA Xoossa Keeththaninne ba kawoteththa keeththan attida worqqanne bira ubbaa kessidi ba oosanchchata kushen woththides. Histtidi Heziyoonaasa naa Xabrimoona naazas Damasqo kataman de7iza Aaraame kawo Beeni-Hadaades imota histti yeddides.

Histtidi izas, «Kase ta aawassinne ne aawaas istta giddon caaqo qaalay diza mala ha7i ta giddoninne ne giddonkka caaqo qaalay de7o; hekko biranne worqqa tani nees imota immanaas yeddadis. Isra7eele Kawo Baashey ba olanchchata ta biittafe kessana mala neni kase izara caaqettida caaqo qaalaa laalla» gides.

Beeni-Hadaadey kawo Aasi gida qaala ekkidi ba ola gadawata Isra7eele katamata olanaas yeddides; istti Iyoone, Daane, Aabeeli-Beeti-Ma7ika geetettiza katamata, qasse Niftaalemenne Gensereexe ubbaa oli oykkides.
Kawo Baashey hessa siyidi Eraama katama gimbizayssa aggidi Tirxxa geetettiza katamaa guye simmides.

Hessafe guye Kawo Aasi Yuhudan de7iza asay ubbay attontta kezana mala awajjissides; Baashey kase heen go7ettiza shuchchaanne miththaa Eraamappe miiyida. Kawo Aasi Mixiphphaninne Biniyaame biittan de7iza Geeba izan minththi gimbides.
Aasi hanida hanotati, iza minoteth ubbay, izi ooththida oosotinne izi essida katamati Yuhuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetti uttida. Gido attiin izi cimmida wode toho sakettides.
Aasi hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttides; ba makakulle Dawite katamankka moogettides. Iza naa Iyoosaafixey izasohon kawotides.
Isra7eele Kawo Nadaabe
Yuhuda Kawo Aasi kawotida nam7anththo layth Iyorba7aame naa Nadaabey Isra7eelen kawotides; izi Isra7eele biittaa nam7u layth haarides.
Nadaabey kase ba aaway nagara ooththida Isra7eele asay nagara ooththana mala kaaleththides.
He wode Nadaabeynne iza olanchchati Filisxeemen diza Gabatoone katama dooddi dishin Yisakoore zare gidida Akaya naa Baashey Nadaabe bolla dendidi iza wodhides.
Yuhuda Kawo Aasi kawotida heedzdzanththo layththan Baashey Nadaabe wodhidi izasohon kawotides.
Baashey kawotida mala Iyorba7aame soo asaa ubbaa wodhi wursides; GODAY Seeloppe yida ba ashkaraa nabe Akaya baggara yootida mala Iyorba7aame keeththa asay ubbay hayqqi wurides.
Hessi haniday Iyorba7aamey ba hu7en ooththida nagaraa gishshas, Isra7eele asaa izi oosisida nagaraa gishshassinne GODAA Isra7eele Xoossaa hanqeththida gishshassa.
Nadaabey hanida hanotatinne izi ooththida oosoti ubbay Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafetti uttida.
Yuhuda Kawo Aasinne Isra7eele Kawo Baashey bantta layth ubbaan olettishe de7ida.
Isra7eele Kawo Baashe
Yuhuda Kawo Aasi kawotida heedzdzanththo layththan Akaya naa Baashey Isra7eele asaa ubbaa bolla kawotides; izi Tirxxa kataman 24 layth kawotides.
Iyorba7aamey Isra7eele asaa oosisida nagaraa ooththidinne iza ogen hemettidi Baashey GODAA sinththan iita miish ooththides.
